name: GoFintech Quantum Innovation Limited
summary: GoFintech Quantum Innovation Limited, an investment holding company, provides investment banking, securities brokerage, asset management, margin financing, investment immigration, debt investment, and equity investment in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. It operates through Securities Brokerage and Margin Financing, Corporate Finance, Money Lending, Asset Management, Equity Investment, Supply Chain Operations, and artworks investment segments. The company offers brokerage services, margin financing, securities placing and underwriting businesses.
